name: Report Parameters 2
definition: Provides the parameters of the report.

ReportDateAndTime.name: Report Date And Time
ReportDateAndTime.definition: Date (and time) at which the report was created.

ReportCurrency.name: Report Currency
ReportCurrency.definition: Indicates the currency used for the calculation of the guarantee fund.

CalculationDate.name: Calculation Date
CalculationDate.definition: Indicates the date of calculation of the deficit (if any).
